season.evidence: Stored best season late July-September fits a snow-free off-trail climb in the Pickets country; only 9 logged summits (Jun 2, Jul 4, Aug 3). Web search found no guidebook or agency page to change it.

track.why: Only route on the peak. 2026-06-13 summit, part of a Mystery Ridge loop: climbs Porkbelly Ridge from the Bacon Creek road end, tops out 2 m from our summit pin and ends at camp near Berdeen Lake, the line our approach text describes. Mid-June, within a month of the window, with snow on the ground. CAUTION: it starts 644 m from our trailhead pin and does not return, so the mechanical 300 m rule fails.

notes: Trailhead not moved: the track starts at 48.65034,-121.42484 (243 m elevation), 644 m north of our Bacon Creek Road End pin (48.64467,-121.42308, 850 ft), but I could not confirm any road-end coordinate from an official or mapped source (searches returned nothing useful). Either the road end is farther up the old roadbed or our pin is short; check a USFS road map before moving. The single report has no text, so no facts. Our monthBreakdown calls June snowbound/risky; this party used an ice axe and bivouac on 6/13 and succeeded, so June is feasible with snow gear.
